朝鮮總督府統計年報 1922

Chōsen Sōtokufu tōkei nenpō (Statistical Annual of the Government-General of Korea), 大正十一年 (Taishō 11): 第2編, 第3編其ノ1, 第4編, 第5編, 第7編
朝鮮總督府, 京城, 1923–1924 (大正十二–十三年)

Five of the parts (編) of the 1922 annual are transcribed: 第2編, 第3編其ノ1, 第4編, 第5編 and 第7編, with all their 251 numbered tables and the 59 small tables of the 統計便覽 booklet bound into 第4編 (326 tables, about 104,000 figure cells), and their contents; the 凡例, the contents pages and the colophons are not. The other parts of the annual are not included. Each part numbers its tables and pages from 1, so table numbers repeat between parts; the printed contents are divided by part. Divider leaves carry small summary boxes, transcribed as unnumbered tables. Re-shot duplicate frames and dark ghost frames were skipped. Tables printed across both pages of a spread are joined into one; long tables were read in sections by different readers and joined. Each spread was read once by a Claude Sonnet agent from tight crops, with no second reading. 1,636 cells could not be read and are marked [?] (893 of them in 第5編, whose scan is soft and low in contrast). Printed totals were re-added; those that do not add up are kept as printed and noted, and where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted. Where the original prints a question mark (unknown figures for early years) it is kept as ?.
